title.es: El de cuando aceptan la boda
title.en: The One Where They Agree to Marry

description.es: Fina y Pelayo intentan convencer a Marta de que siga adelante con la boda. Marta y Pelayo le dicen a Damián que se van a casar, y hacen una celebración en familia.
description.en: Fina and Pelayo try to persuade Marta to go through with the marriage. Marta and Pelayo tell Damián that they are going to marry, and they hold a celebration within the family.
